queries.GetAgentDefinitions:
query GetAgentDefinitions {
  agentDefinitions {
    __typename
    id
    name
    role
    description
    instructions
    category
    avatarUrl
    toolNames
    inputProcessorNames
    llmResponseProcessorNames
    toolExecutionResultProcessorNames
    toolInvocationPreprocessorNames
    lifecycleProcessorNames
    skillNames
    skillScope
    ownershipScope
    ownerTeamId
    ownerTeamName
    ownerApplicationId
    ownerApplicationName
    ownerPackageId
    ownerLocalApplicationId
    defaultLaunchConfig {
      llmModelIdentifier
      runtimeKind
      llmConfig
      __typename
    }
    loadIssue {
      code
      reason
      definitionPath
      packageRoot
      __typename
    }
  }
}
queries.GetAgentOrgDefinitions:
query GetAgentOrgDefinitions {
  agentOrgDefinitions {
    id
    name
    description
    instructions
    category
    avatarUrl
    revision
    handoffs {
      from
      to
      rules
      __typename
    }
    members {
      memberName
      ref
      refType
      refScope
      __typename
    }
    defaultLaunchConfig {
      llmModelIdentifier
      runtimeKind
      llmConfig
      __typename
    }
    loadIssues {
      kind
      definitionId
      name
      code
      reason
      definitionPath
      packageRoot
      usingLastGood
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
